edges.reason: The lever directly powers the iron door at X=15; flipping it opens the only path to the fire room
The fire room exit at X=19 is the only doorway leading to the banner room at X=20-22
The banner room connects via doorway at X=23 to the glass pane display in Room 4
The villager is in the same Room 4 as the glass panes; player reaches both after entering
Both use the same crafting table; planks craft confirms table interaction before stairs recipe
Stairs crafting confirms crafting proficiency needed before the spatial cube-building challenge
Chestplate craft demonstrates full inventory management before anvil station interaction
Anvil interaction confirms workshop area mastery; build zone is adjacent past the anvil station

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia planks from acacia logs results in planks appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with acacia logs but no planks, so any acacia_planks in inventory confirms crafting occurred.

Uses inventory_has because crafting spruce stairs from spruce planks results in stairs appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with spruce planks but no stairs, so any spruce_stairs in inventory confirms crafting occurred.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a leather chestplate from leather results in the chestplate appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with raw leather but no chestplate, so any leather_chestplate in inventory confirms crafting occurred.

Uses position_near_with_facing because interacting with the anvil requires the player to navigate to it and face it. The anvil is at spawn-relative (8,0,1) — 8 blocks from spawn — so the player must intentionally walk there. max_distance=2 ensures the player is within right-click interaction range, and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are looking directly at the anvil. This is the best available approximation for GUI interaction with current rule types.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a 3x3x3 cobblestone cube results in 27 cobblestone blocks placed in the designated build zone. The build zone is at spawn-relative (3-5, 0-2, 5-7) marked with gold corner blocks. A generous detection box (2-6, -1-3, 4-8) accounts for slight misplacement while still requiring all 27 blocks to be placed in the zone area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because finding the lever requires the player to navigate through the doorway at X=10 into Room 1 and look at the lever on the door wall. The lever is at spawn-relative (15, 0, 3) directly adjacent to the iron door. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered Room 1, and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are looking toward the lever.

Uses position_near_with_facing because finding the fire requires the player to pass through the iron door (gated by the lever) into Room 2 and observe the fire. The fire is at spawn-relative (17, 1, 5) on netherrack. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered Room 2 (past the iron door at X=15), and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are looking at the fire.

Uses position_near_with_facing because finding the light gray banner requires the player to navigate through Room 2 into Room 3 and observe the banner. The banner is at spawn-relative (21, 0, 5). max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered Room 3 (past the wall at X=19), and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are looking at the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because finding the blue stained glass panes requires the player to navigate into Room 4 and observe the glass wall. The glass panes span (24, 0-2, 6-8), with center at spawn-relative (24, 1, 7). max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered Room 4 (past the wall at X=23), and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are looking at the glass panes.

Uses position_near_with_facing because talking to the villager requires the player to be within right-click interaction range and facing the villager. The villager is at spawn-relative (24, 0, 3) with NoAI so it stays in place. max_distance=2 ensures the player is within actual interaction range (Minecraft right-click reach is ~3 blocks), and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are oriented toward the villager.

scene_description: A two-part scene: (1) A workshop area near spawn with crafting table, anvil, and a designated cube-building zone marked with gold blocks, and (2) A linear corridor of gated rooms for exploration tasks. The lever at position (15,0,3) directly powers an adjacent iron door, mechanically gating access to the fire room. The corridor forces sequential traversal through rooms containing fire, a light gray banner, blue stained glass panes, and a villager.
task_text: Complete a series of crafting and exploration challenges in this workshop-corridor complex. First, use the crafting table to craft acacia planks from logs, spruce stairs from planks, and a leather chestplate from leather. Then interact with the anvil and build a 3x3x3 cobblestone cube in the marked build zone (gold corner markers). Finally, explore the corridor: find and flip the lever to open the iron door, then proceed through the rooms to find fire, a light gray banner, blue stained glass panes, and talk to the villager at the end.
design_notes:
FINAL LAYOUT:

- Player spawns at origin (0,0,0).
- Workshop (X=-2 to X=9):
  - Crafting table: (1, 0, 1)
  - Anvil: (8, 0, 1) — 8 blocks from spawn
  - Build zone: (3-5, 0-2, 5-7) with 8 gold corner markers
- Dividing wall at X=10 with 2-wide, 2-high doorway at Z=4-5
- Room 1 - Lever Room (X=11-14):
  - Lever: (15, 0, 3) on support block (15, 0, 2), face=wall, facing=south
  - Iron door: (15, 0-1, 4) — directly adjacent to lever, receives power when lever is flipped
- Room 2 - Fire Room (X=16-18):
  - Fire on netherrack: (17, 1, 5)
  - Wall at X=19 with doorway at Z=4-5
- Room 3 - Banner Room (X=20-22):
  - Light gray banner: (21, 0, 5)
  - Wall at X=23 with doorway at Z=4-5
- Room 4 - Glass & Villager (X=24):
  - Blue stained glass panes: (24, 0-2, 6-8)
  - Villager (librarian, NoAI): (24, 0, 3)

REDSTONE MECHANISM:
- Lever at (15,0,3) with face=wall,facing=south is attached to support block at (15,0,2)
- The lever occupies the same position as the wall fill at Z=3, so the /setblock overwrites the stone_bricks with the lever
- When flipped, the lever acts as a power source at (15,0,3)
- The iron door at (15,0,4) is directly adjacent (1 block south) and receives power
- No redstone wire needed — direct adjacency powers the door

MATERIALS:
- 4 acacia logs → 16 planks (need 4 for milestone)
- 6 spruce planks → 4 stairs
- 8 leather → 1 chestplate
- 27 cobblestone → 3x3x3 cube
- No XP needed (no rename task)
